projects.name: mini-llm
projects.tagline: A small character-level language model built with PyTorch.
projects.description: A from-scratch language model you can train on your own text and chat with in the terminal. Includes a training script with automatic CUDA detection, CPU-friendly configuration presets for common hardware, checkpoint saving, and an interactive agent with chat memory and sampling controls.
points: Character-level transformer trained with a single `python train.py` command
Interactive chat agent with memory, /save, /clear, and temperature controls
Auto-selects CUDA when available, with tuned CPU presets for low-end hardware
Checkpoints saved to checkpoints/mini_llm.pt for instant inference after training

projects.name: IslaSafe Admin
projects.tagline: React + TypeScript dashboard for monitoring SOS requests and hazards.
projects.description: An admin web app for monitoring SOS requests, incidents, hazard maps, evacuation centers, advisories, residents, and weather conditions. Built with Vite, Tailwind CSS, and MapLibre GL for interactive map views, with all configuration read from environment variables.
points: Live monitoring of SOS requests, incidents, and weather conditions
Interactive hazard and evacuation-center maps powered by MapLibre GL
Feature-based folder structure with shared UI primitives
Env-driven configuration via a typed environment module and oxlint checks
Built and shipped mini-llm, a trainable character-level language model in PyTorch
Developed the IslaSafe admin dashboard (React, TypeScript, MapLibre) for SOS and hazard monitoring
Practice daily with TypeScript, React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS — learning by shipping
